question_response: Prof. Jones is knowledgeable but the lectures move too fast. I often left class feeling more confused than when I arrived.
I struggled to follow along most of the time. It felt like prior knowledge was assumed that was never actually covered in class.
The class environment felt unwelcoming at times. Some questions were brushed off which made me afraid to ask for help.
I felt like my questions were dismissed compared to other students. It was discouraging and made me disengage from the material.
The content is interesting but the delivery needs significant improvement. I learn differently and the current format does not work for me.
Prof. Jones rarely acknowledged students who raised equity concerns about the course materials. That felt dismissive and frustrating.
The slides need to be posted before class not after. Some students take longer to process information and need them in advance.
Grading was inconsistent across sections. Students in other sections got more feedback than we did which feels unfair.
Office hours were almost never available at times that worked for students who commute or have jobs. This is a structural problem.
The textbook was extremely expensive and no alternative was provided. Not everyone can afford that and it should be considered.
I did not feel comfortable speaking up in class. The environment felt like it rewarded certain types of students over others.
More worked examples and slower pacing would help a lot. The current approach leaves many students behind.
